name: pdscope
description: USB Power Delivery 抓包解析上位机 — 直接解析正点原子 ATK-C (.atkcc) 抓包文件
author: PDScope

scripts.e2e:ufcs:synth: node tools/make-test-ufcs.mjs && node tools/e2e.mjs --file dist/PDScope.html --drop "artifacts/_ufcs_synth.sqlite" --out artifacts/e2e-ufcs-synth.png
scripts.e2e:multi: node tools/e2e.mjs --file dist/PDScope.html --drop "../制糖40w-ip18pro.atkcc" --drop2 "../山泽60w-ip18pro.sqlite" --out artifacts/e2e-multi.png
scripts.e2e:all: npm run e2e && npm run e2e:powerz && npm run e2e:ufcs && npm run e2e:multi
scripts.test: node tools/version-check.mjs && node tools/syntax.mjs && node tools/build-standalone.mjs && node tools/selftest.js && node tools/ackcheck.js && npm run e2e:all
scripts.perf:worst: npm run perf:fixture && node tools/perf-probe.mjs --headed --file dist/PDScope.html --drop "artifacts/_worst.atkcc"
scripts.check: npm test && npm run app:test && npm run app:test:open
